mapper.sql: campaign_id as campaignId, venue_id as venueId, title, subtitle, rules, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, reward_cents as rewardCents, status, create_time as createTime
mapper.select: select from fish_card_campaign where status = '0' and end_time >= sysdate() order by case when start_time <= sysdate() then 0 else 1 end, start_time asc limit 1

select species_id as speciesId, campaign_id as campaignId, species_name as speciesName, card_image as cardImage, sort_num as sortNum, status from fish_card_species where campaign_id = #{campaignId} and status = '0' order by sort_num asc, species_id asc

select species_id as speciesId, campaign_id as campaignId, species_name as speciesName, card_image as cardImage, sort_num as sortNum, status from fish_card_species where campaign_id = #{campaignId} and species_id = #{speciesId} and status = '0' limit 1

select round_id as roundId, campaign_id as campaignId, user_id as userId, round_no as roundNo, status, started_time as startedTime, completed_time as completedTime, duration_seconds as durationSeconds, reward_cents as rewardCents, reward_status as rewardStatus, reward_paid_time as rewardPaidTime from fish_card_round where campaign_id = #{campaignId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0 order by round_no desc limit 1

select round_id as roundId, campaign_id as campaignId, user_id as userId, round_no as roundNo, status, started_time as startedTime, completed_time as completedTime, duration_seconds as durationSeconds, reward_cents as rewardCents, reward_status as rewardStatus, reward_paid_time as rewardPaidTime from fish_card_round where round_id = #{roundId}
select coalesce(max(round_no), 0) from fish_card_round where campaign_id = #{campaignId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into fish_card_round (campaign_id, user_id, round_no, status, started_time, reward_cents, reward_status, create_time) values (#{campaignId}, #{userId}, #{roundNo}, 0, sysdate(), #{rewardCents}, 0, sysdate())
mapper.select: select progress_id as progressId, round_id as roundId, species_id as speciesId, catch_id as catchId, status, submitted_time as submittedTime, reviewed_time as reviewedTime from fish_card_progress where round_id = #{roundId} and species_id = #{speciesId} limit 1

select progress_id as progressId, round_id as roundId, species_id as speciesId, catch_id as catchId, status, submitted_time as submittedTime, reviewed_time as reviewedTime from fish_card_progress where catch_id = #{catchId} limit 1

select p.progress_id as progressId, p.round_id as roundId, p.species_id as speciesId, p.catch_id as catchId, p.status, p.submitted_time as submittedTime, p.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, c.video_url as videoUrl, c.reject_reason as rejectReason from fish_card_progress p left join fish_catch_record c on c.catch_id = p.catch_id where p.round_id = #{roundId}
mapper.insert: insert into fish_card_progress (round_id, species_id, catch_id, status, submitted_time, create_time) values (#{roundId}, #{speciesId}, #{catchId}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update catch_id = values(catch_id), status = 0, submitted_time = sysdate(), reviewed_time = null, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update fish_card_progress set status = #{status}, reviewed_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where catch_id = #{catchId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from fish_card_progress where round_id = #{roundId} and status = 1
mapper.update: update fish_card_round set status = 1, completed_time = sysdate(), duration_seconds = timestampdiff(second, started_time, sysdate()), update_time = sysdate() where round_id = #{roundId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select r.user_id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, count(*) as completedRounds, min(r.duration_seconds) as bestDurationSeconds, min(r.completed_time) as firstCompletedTime from fish_card_round r left join fish_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status = 1 group by r.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar order by bestDurationSeconds asc, firstCompletedTime asc limit 6

select r.round_id as roundId, r.campaign_id as campaignId, c.title, r.user_id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, r.round_no as roundNo, r.status, r.started_time as startedTime, r.completed_time as completedTime, r.duration_seconds as durationSeconds, r.reward_cents as rewardCents, r.reward_status as rewardStatus, r.reward_paid_time as rewardPaidTime, r.reward_paid_by as rewardPaidBy from fish_card_round r left join fish_card_campaign c on c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id left join fish_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id

order by r.completed_time desc, r.create_time desc
mapper.update: update fish_card_round set reward_status = 1, reward_paid_time = sysdate(), reward_paid_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where round_id = #{roundId} and status = 1 and reward_status = 0
